Specifically, for every 10-year increase in age, the odds of a modified sustained virological response decrease by a factor of 0.896. The analysis was conducted at 24 weeks after the end of treatment.

outcomeTitle: Percentage of Participants With Modified Sustained Virological Response by Genotype in Modified All-Treated Population
groupDescription: The statistical analysis is presented for BMI in kg/m\^2. The logistic regression analysis for mSVR was performed for association between treatment exposure and baseline factors available in at least 90% of participants (including total cumulative dose of peginterferon and ribavirin), in naive HCV mono-infected mTRT participants receiving PEG-IFN alfa-2a.
briefTitle: PROPHESYS 1: An Observational Study on Predictors of Response in Treatment-naïve Patients With Chronic Hepatitis C Virus (HCV)Treated With Pegasys (Peginterferon Alfa-2a)
FINDING: In patients with Genotype 1, there is a statistically significant association between a patient's BMI and decreased odds of achieving a modified sustained virological response (mSVR). Specifically, for every 1 kg/m^2 increase in BMI, the odds of achieving a modified sustained virological response decrease by a factor of 0.971. The analysis was conducted at 24 weeks after the end of treatment.

outcomeTitle: Percentage of Participants With Modified Sustained Virological Response by Type of Peginterferon and Genotype in Modified All Treated Population
groupDescription: The statistical analysis is presented for on-treatment response (pEVR \[Partial Early Virological Response\] vs No RVR/EVR). The logistic regression analysis for mSVR was performed for association between on-treatment response and baseline factors available in at least 90% of participants, in naive HCV mono-infected mTRT participants receiving PEG-IFN alfa-2a.
briefTitle: PROPHESYS 2: An Observational Study on Predictors of Response in Treatment-naïve Patients With Chronic Hepatitis C Treated With Pegasys (Peginterferon Alfa-2a) or Peginterferon-alfa-2b
FINDING: In patients with Genotype 1 receiving PEG-IFN alfa-2a, there is a statistically significant association between achieving a partial early virological response (pEVR) and increased odds of achieving a modified sustained virological response (mSVR). Specifically, patients who achieved a partial early virological response had 2.519 times the odds of achieving a modified sustained virological response compared to patients with no early virological response. The analysis was conducted at 24 weeks after the end of treatment.

outcomeTitle: Percentage of Participants With Relapse After Modified End of Treatment Response by Genotype in Modified All-Treated Population at 24 Weeks After End of Treatment
groupDescription: The statistical analysis is presented for HCV RNA at BL in log10 (IU/mL). The logistic regression analysis for relapse was performed for association between treatment response and baseline factors available in at least 90% of participants, in naive HCV mono-infected mTRT participants receiving PEG-IFN alfa-2a.
briefTitle: PROPHESYS 2: An Observational Study on Predictors of Response in Treatment-naïve Patients With Chronic Hepatitis C Treated With Pegasys (Peginterferon Alfa-2a) or Peginterferon-alfa-2b
FINDING: In patients with Genotype 1 receiving PEG-IFN alfa-2a, there is a statistically significant association between a higher baseline HCV RNA level and increased odds of relapse. Specifically, for every 1 log10 (IU/mL) increase in baseline HCV RNA, the odds of a participant relapsing increase by a factor of 1.590. The analysis was conducted at 24 weeks after the end of treatment.

outcomeTitle: Pain Freedom at 2 Hours Post Dose in Participants Between 6 and 17 Years of Age
groupDescription: The comparison of rizatriptan versus placebo with respect to pain freedom at 2 hours post Stage 2 dose for participants between 6 and 17 years of age was conducted using a logistic regression model with factors for treatment, Stage 2 baseline pain severity (moderate or severe), age (6 to 11 years old or 12 to 17 years old), and region (US or ex-US). Model-derived odds ratio and a two-sided p-value were provided. An odds ratio \>1 is in favor of the rizatriptan group.
briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Tolerability of Rizatriptan for Treatment of Acute Migraine in Children and Adolescents (MK-0462-082 AM7)
FINDING: There is a statistically significant association between the use of rizatriptan and increased odds of achieving pain freedom. Specifically, participants who received rizatriptan had 1.52 times the odds of achieving pain freedom compared to participants who received placebo. The analysis was conducted on participants between 6 and 17 years of age and measured pain freedom at 2 hours post-dose.

outcomeTitle: Duration of Labor Analgesia
briefTitle: The Association Between Decreasing Labor Analgesia Epidural Infusion and Forceps Delivery
FINDING: There is a statistically significant association between the type of delivery and the duration of labor analgesia. outcomeTitle: Number of Patients Who Reported No Vomiting
briefTitle: Aprepitant for the Prevention of Chemotherapy Induced Nausea and Vomiting (CINV)(0869-130)(COMPLETED)
FINDING: There is a statistically significant association between the use of the Aprepitant Regimen and an increased rate of no vomiting. Specifically, 76.2% of patients on the Aprepitant Regimen reported no vomiting, compared to 62.1% of patients on the Standard Regimen. The analysis was conducted over the overall phase (0-120 hours post initiation of MEC) in Cycle 1.

outcomeTitle: Number of Patients Who Reported Complete Response
briefTitle: Aprepitant for the Prevention of Chemotherapy Induced Nausea and Vomiting (CINV)(0869-130)(COMPLETED)
FINDING: There is a statistically significant association between the use of the Aprepitant Regimen and an increased rate of complete response. Specifically, 68.7% of patients on the Aprepitant Regimen reported a complete response (no vomiting and no use of rescue medication), compared to 56.3% of patients on the Standard Regimen. The analysis was conducted over the overall phase (0-120 hours post initiation of MEC) in Cycle 1.

groupDescription: Late GU toxicity rates were tabulated and dichotomized as \< grade 2 vs ≥ grade 2. To evaluate the differences by treatment arm, 2 X 2 subtables were formed and relative risk (RR) estimates with 95% CIs were computed.
briefTitle: Radiation Therapy in Treating Patients With Stage II Prostate Cancer

outcomeTitle: INITIATION: Rate of Self-reported Hypoglycemic Episodes
briefTitle: The DURABLE Trial: Evaluating the Durability of Starter Insulin Regimens in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes (IOOV)
FINDING: There is a statistically significant association between the type of insulin and the rate of hypoglycemia episodes. Specifically, participants on the Insulin Glargine regimen experienced a lower mean rate of hypoglycemia episodes (20.28 episodes/participant/year) compared to those on the Lispro Low Mix regimen (24.96 episodes/participant/year). The analysis was conducted over a 24-week period.

outcomeTitle: Risk Factors for Perinatal HIV-1 Transmission
briefTitle: Trial of Three Neonatal Antiretroviral Regimens for Prevention of Intrapartum HIV Transmission

The analysis was conducted for the time period through age 3 months.
